mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of a shower enclosure installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of shower enclosure installation varies based on several factors, including the type of enclosure (framed, frameless), glass thickness, size, and any custom features like unique hardware or etched designs. The complexity of the installation, such as needing to adjust plumbing or resolve uneven wall surfaces, can also affect the final price. We provide detailed estimates after assessing your specific project needs.
